notablePrerequisites: Chandra in hand.You have at least one red instant and/or sorcery in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Chandra by paying {4}{R}{R}, causing it to enter with ten loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Activate Chandra's third loyalty ability by removing seven loyalty counters from it, casting a red instant and/or sorcery from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Chandra, causing it to enter with ten loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the instant or sorcery spell.
Repeat from step 2.
